reason.held: held by a compression in progress

reason.changed: the file changed since the library was read
reason.not_writable: the server cannot write that folder

reason.partial: only some of its files moved (the others stay)
reason.unreadable: a folder could not be read
reason.state: its compression cannot be changed now

reason.unstable_inode: the NAS mount does not keep file identities (CIFS without serverino, FUSE)

move.nothing: Nothing in this selection can go to the trash.

move.nas_other: {{count}} on the NAS ({{files}} files with their sidecars)
move.server_one: {{count}} only on the server (phone backups, uploads)
move.server_other: {{count}} only on the server (phone backups, uploads)
move.blocked: The NAS shots cannot move now: {{reason}}. Nothing will be moved.
move.onlyCopy_one: {{count}} is the only copy anywhere (not on the NAS or a phone): emptying the trash deletes it for good.
move.onlyCopy_other: {{count}} are the only copies anywhere (not on the NAS or a phone): emptying the trash deletes them for good.
move.edits_one: {{count}} has Reveal's edits: they stay in the trash and come back on a restore.
move.edits_other: {{count}} have Reveal's edits: they stay in the trash and come back on a restore.

profile.label: Look
profile.sameDesc: HEVC cq 28: the approved look, about a fifth of the size.
profile.smallerDesc: HEVC cq 30: about 1 VMAF point less for another 15–25 % of size.
profile.av1Desc: AV1 cq 34: 14–22 % smaller than HEVC; plays only where AV1 decodes in hardware.

quality.label: Quality
quality.floorDesc: cq 28, encoded again at a lower q only when VMAF is under 93.
quality.fixedDesc: One encode at the profile's q, no re-encode.
quality.targetDesc: Searches the q that reaches the VMAF below (2–3 encodes per video).
